meta.title: DeFi Compliance & AML | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: AML screening, counterparty diligence, and monitoring for DeFi protocols and crypto infrastructure teams — with configurable rules and documented scope.

Hero.subtitle: Screen wallets and flows, review protocol counterparties, and integrate compliance checks into your operations — without claiming DeFi can be made fully permissionless and regulation-free.

Overview.title: Compliance that fits how DeFi actually works
Overview.description: Lenix helps protocol teams, treasuries, and infrastructure providers assess exposure across supported networks — pool interactions, bridge touchpoints, and wallet screening — with outputs your compliance function can audit, not opaque risk scores alone.

scale.title: Scale screening without losing review quality
scale.desc: Configurable rules and batch review help compliance teams focus on material exposure — not manual lookup for every wallet touch.

cost.title: Integrate into existing workflows
cost.desc: API and export options fit internal queues and case tools so screening does not sit in a separate silo.

coverage.title: Cross-chain context where supported
coverage.desc: Review activity across networks and token types your program covers — with limits stated when a chain or asset is outside scope.

threats.title: Proactive counterparty review
threats.desc: Assess pools, routers, and wallet connections before treasury moves or partner onboarding — bounded to your policy definitions.

coverage.label: Asset coverage
coverage.title: Screen activity across supported chains
coverage.body: Evaluate transactions and wallet exposure on major Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, stablecoins, and common token standards used in DeFi — scoped to networks and assets covered under your engagement.

integration.label: API integration
integration.title: Bring screening into your stack
integration.body: Connect Lenix outputs to internal review queues, case management, or custom tooling via API and file exports — so compliance steps stay in workflows your team already runs.

screening.label: Transaction screening
screening.title: Flag exposure before funds move
screening.body: Review wallets and transactions for links to sanctioned entities, known scam typologies, and high-risk service categories — with results your team can accept, escalate, or override with notes.

monitoring.label: Automated monitoring
monitoring.title: Watchlists for protocols and treasuries
monitoring.body: Monitor address sets, pool interactions, and recurring counterparty flows. Alert rules and coverage depend on supported networks and how your program defines material risk.

onboarding.label: Counterparty onboarding
onboarding.title: Review partners before integration
onboarding.body: Screen liquidity providers, pool contracts, and wallet counterparties during onboarding — surfacing exposure across supported chains when your policy requires it.

diligence.label: Protocol due diligence
diligence.title: Map exposure across the ecosystem
diligence.body: Analyze how a protocol connects to exchanges, bridges, and high-risk services in on-chain data — with written limits on what public ledgers can and cannot show about off-chain control.

Cta.title: Building compliance into a DeFi product?
Cta.description: Share your protocol type, jurisdictions, and what you need to screen or monitor. We outline realistic integration scope before engagement.
